title: SCP deny guardrail
note: IAM-1301: an EXPLICIT SCP selection routes to the family-aware SCP ceiling/guardrail evaluator (engine/scp.js). Deny statements are GUARDRAILS (organization-departure deny + region deny with a global-service NotAction carve-out), never grants. The NotAction list is a carve-out (excludedActions), NEVER reported as allowed capabilities. Zero positive capability edges; every finding states SCPs set permission ceilings and do not grant (intersection with identity policies not supplied). Compare with the auto-detect fail-closed baseline in fixtures/acceptance-2-deferred/test-43 and the family gate's UNSUPPORTED_SCP_SHAPE under auto-detect.
